assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, Illumina HiSeq 4000), human vastus lateralis biopsies (S2.4.p1)
sample_inclusion: 4 lean + 4 obese adults, each biopsied at rest (pre) and 3.5 h after 30 min single-leg cycling at 70% VO2peak (post); 16 libraries (ABS.p2, S2.1.p1, S2.3.p1)
repeated_measure_unit: subject (pre and post biopsy from the same person; rest biopsy right leg, post biopsy exercised left leg, separate days) (S2.3.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-person transcriptional response to a single bout of endurance exercise (post vs pre), estimated separately in lean and in obese participants (S3.2.p1, FIG2)
planned_contrasts: lean: post vs pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 419 up, 132 down = 551 DEGs)
obese: post vs pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 82 up, 22 down = 104 DEGs)
baseline obese vs lean pre (S3.1.p1; 97 up, 65 down) - not an exercise contrast, out of scope
paper_method: edgeR negative-binomial GLM on featureCounts gene counts (S2.4.p1); design terms and subject blocking not stated
paper_normalization: edgeR (deposited file is edgeR-normalized CPM, GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S3.1.p1 (adjusted p < 0.05, log2(fold-change) > +/-0.5); FIG2/FIG7 report FDR / adjusted p = 0.05

paper_pathways: GSEA: lean post-exercise downregulation of mitochondrial translation and OXPHOS gene sets, upregulation of RTK signaling; obese: no regulated transcript gene sets (S3.2.p2)
